parts.notes: Only the north third of 부천중앙공원 lies inside this photo: the grid of lawns and paved walks on the west (tree/grass side), the twin glass geodesic domes, two toilets with small domes, six white-framed underground-parking entrances, the diagonal tree-lined promenade and the start of the east water side (dark pond, teal stream channel, tan paths). The symbol tower, the 야외음악당 shell stage, the central oval lawn, the big fountain/pond with island and the 능소화 tunnel are south of y 2304 and need the cell to the south. Path widths from OSM width tags where present, otherwise measured. Pixel coordinates are traced from the photo; OSM geometry is offset 10-40 px in places (its NW diagonal walk does not match the curved arc seen in the photo). No web image was saved.

notes: Covers the rest of 부천중앙공원 outside the north-third file. Part 1cb = the west section (1cb x < 1024, i.e. west of the north file's x 0): sports block (clay tennis courts, 족구장, basketball court, sand playground, two 게이트볼장 under white tensile membrane roofs, 장기클럽 hut, outdoor exercise area), 숲속작은도서관 and its paved yards, the wide E-W walk, the tree-lined N-S walks, the south-west woodland trail loop, the west part of the 능소화 tunnel promenade and the SW gate pergola/toilet. Part 153 = everything south of the north file (153 y > 1024, x 0..1520; 153 x == 1cf x, 153 y == 1cf y - 1280; the two photos are pixel-identical where they overlap): the brick plaza main body, the two dotted-paver axes, inner oval walk, west and east fan gardens with tan paths, the outer ring walk, the symbol tower and its round plaza, the Bucheon letter sign, the east water side (big pond with island, 물놀이장 splash pad with hand-shaped pool, winding stream from OSM, wavy striped walkway with 8 white round objects, teal rubber walks), the concentric round plaza and dark forecourt in the south, woodland trails, toilet. No 야외음악당: 부천타임즈 (2023) says the 1993 stage was demolished after the 2014 safety inspection and never rebuilt; the photo shows no shell, so stage is null (the white shell in the north file's old aerial is the pre-2014 stage). No domes south of the north file. Paths follow OSM where it matches the photo within ~10 px (west section, east water side) and are hand-traced where OSM is missing or off (fan paths, oval arcs, west edge walk, pond outline). Doubts: tower base +-2 m and blade yaw (from web thumbnails, medium confidence); the striped walkway may be a shallow water feature rather than painted rubber (OSM calls it a width-8 footway); the stream is OSM-only (hidden by canopy); woodland lawn polygons are coarse and overlap path lines on purpose. A thin teal band runs along the park's west and south kerbs (possibly a cycle lane or a planted channel) and is left out. The park's extreme SW corner below 1cb y 2304 (a few metres) is in neither photo. No web image was saved.
